correctness.rationale: Every cycle tree deletes one edge J and |S triangle T|=|A triangle {J}|>=|M-1|. Conditional on S, choose J uniformly from missing-edge set A if nonempty, otherwise uniformly from all edges; rotation invariance makes the marginal of J uniform, proving exact pathwise optimality simultaneously for every nondecreasing loss. Under p-clockwise iid vertex directions missing edges are cyclic 0-to-1 transitions; k>0 alternations comprise k runs of each orientation and count n/k times two positive-composition counts, weighted by p^a q^(n-a); M=0 iff all bits equal. Adjacent indicators exclude each other, nonadjacent independent, giving EM=npq and Var M=npq(1-3pq), and the exact expected cost. Bounded 1-dependence CLT gives fixed-bias Gaussian. For np_n->lambda rare p_n, number of rare clockwise bits is asymptotically Poisson and adjacent rare bits occur with probability <=np_n^2, so M converges to Poisson and Delta to |Pois(lambda)-1|. Independently enumerated every binary word n=3..10 at rational biases and checked exact masses, variance and mean; finite enumeration corroborates, not replaces, all-n proofs.
residual_risks: Independent bounded checks do not replace the analytic proof; scope limited to stated assumptions.
